actions.headline_en: Boiler 1: steam temperature drifting. Check feed-water dosing and blowdown now.
actions.headline_ms: Dandang 1: suhu stim menyimpang. Semak dos air suapan dan blowdown sekarang.

reasons.text_en: Steam temperature has sat below its normal 530–545 °C band for 4 hours
reasons.text_ms: Suhu stim berada di bawah julat biasa 530–545 °C selama 4 jam

reasons.text_en: Steam pressure is swinging twice as much as usual
reasons.text_ms: Tekanan stim berayun dua kali ganda daripada biasa

reasons.text_en: Feed-water flow is falling while the mill load is steady
reasons.text_ms: Aliran air suapan menurun walaupun beban kilang stabil

actions.why_rank_en: Boiler stops the whole mill, so it comes first
actions.why_rank_ms: Dandang menghentikan seluruh kilang, jadi ia diutamakan

actions.headline_en: Press 2: worm wear. Change the worm at tomorrow's 06:00 stop.
actions.headline_ms: Penekan 2: haus skru cacing. Tukar skru pada henti terancang esok jam 06:00.

reasons.text_en: Motor current per tonne is 9% above Press 2's normal for 5 days
reasons.text_ms: Arus motor setiap tan 9% lebih tinggi daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2 selama 5 hari

reasons.text_en: Oil lost in fibre rose to 3.6% (alarm line is 4%)
reasons.text_ms: Kehilangan minyak dalam serabut meningkat kepada 3.6% (garis amaran 4%)

reasons.text_en: Worm has run 1,310 h since the last change; typical life is about 1,200 h
reasons.text_ms: Skru cacing telah beroperasi 1,310 jam sejak penggantian terakhir; hayat biasa kira-kira 1,200 jam

actions.why_rank_en: Costs less than the boiler, and the fix fits the planned stop
actions.why_rank_ms: Kos lebih rendah daripada dandang, dan pembaikan muat dalam henti terancang
